issue.description:
## Shared verification-failure fingerprint

The gate `shipped_work` in workspace `/home/coding/brand-kit` failed with one identical fingerprint on 5 of the workspace's recent verification failures, across 5 distinct beads. The signal is statistical, not textual: when every failure in a workspace shares a fingerprint, no bead is at fault — the gate is.

### Failure shape
- **Gate**: shipped_work
- **Normalized output**: `commit <id> has substantial changes but has not been pushed to its upstream github/main`
- **Fingerprint**: `50c4429da2e4`
- **Window failures**: 5
- **Distinct beads affected**: 5

### Impact
This workspace is now **gate-degraded**: Pluck and Explore skip it for ordinary dispatch, and failures carrying this fingerprint no longer increment any bead's failure count. The workspace remains claimable — repairing the gate is verified by running it.

### Resolution
Fix the gate so a clean run passes, and the next successful verification in this workspace will clear the degradation, close this bead, and undo the failure penalties recorded while the window was degraded.
issue.title: Gate broken: shipped_work — commit <id> has substantial changes but has not been pushed to i (fingerprint:50c4429da2e4)

issue.description:
tools/build_assets.py output depends on which resvg/vtracer/Pillow versions are installed, and README documents a silent fallback to raster resizing when resvg is unavailable — so the same commit can regenerate different bytes in different environments. The regen-diff CI check (brandkit-cb866485) is only meaningful if the toolchain is pinned: record the exact tool versions that produced the currently committed assets (docs/notes/), install those pinned versions in the CI image, and make build_assets.py exit with an error instead of falling back when resvg is missing, so CI can never pass (or spuriously fail) on fallback output. Complements brandkit-cb866485 without duplicating it.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.notes: Evidence from brandkit-a013f77e reconciliation (2026-09-15): committed assets are NOT plain build_assets.py output. HEAD logo-512.png is palette-mode P — the Aug 14 optimization run (db5b071) post-processed outputs with oxipng color-type reduction, while README lists oxipng as optional. An Aug 20 regen (side effect of brandkit-a44e08ad, left uncommitted ~4 weeks, reverted in brandkit-a013f77e) produced plain Pillow optimize=True RGB outputs 30-150% larger (favicon-32 738->1164B, logo-1024 18693->46394B). Pinning therefore must cover the oxipng post-pass too — or the committed set must be deliberately re-committed from non-oxipng output — otherwise the CI image can regenerate with exact Pillow/resvg versions and still never byte-match HEAD.
issue.title: Pin asset-toolchain versions and remove the silent resvg fallback so the CI regen-diff is deterministic

Evidence: tree PNGs were written 2026-08-20 01:01 under an unpinned toolchain; HEAD's set is oxipng color-reduced (logo-512.png is palette-mode P) while the stranded outputs were plain Pillow optimize=True RGB, 30-150% larger per file (favicon-32 738->1164B, logo-1024 18693->46394B; tree total 10.45MB vs 9.99MB), with no source/ or tool change to justify them. Ran git checkout -- avatars banners favicon logo (explicit paths, no add -A); tools/verify_assets.py passes all 31 dimension checks, exit 0. .needle-predispatch-sha: DOES belong in .gitignore — it is NEEDLE dispatch bookkeeping (HEAD SHA captured at worker dispatch), and 11 sibling repos (NEEDLE, claude-print, domain-check, bead-rs, ...) already ignore it; added /.needle-predispatch-sha alongside the existing traces entry, committed as 1ccc7f1 and pushed to Forgejo origin. Cross-bead record: appended the finding to brandkit-68d7b26c via fencing-token update — pinning must cover the oxipng post-pass (or the committed set must be deliberately re-committed from non-oxipng output) or the ADR-1 regen-diff CI can byte-match nothing. Note: task rules' npm test/lint do not apply here — brand-kit has no package.json; verify_assets.py is the repo's check. Left untouched: .beads checkpoint/diagnostics churn (hourly polish-loop sync's) and docs/notes/ + tools/consumer_sync.py (another worker's in-flight edits in the shared checkout).

Pinned the asset toolchain and removed the silent fallback so the CI regen-diff is deterministic. (1) tools/build_assets.py now aborts with instructions when resvg is missing or a source file (logo.svg / logo-transparent.svg / logo.png / hero.png) is absent - the raster-resize and skip-transparent fallbacks are gone, so fallback output can never pass CI or silently diverge. (2) Exact pins recorded in new docs/notes/asset-toolchain.md: resvg 0.47.0, vtracer 0.6.5, Pillow 12.1.1 - with the load-bearing caveat that Pillow must be the PyPI wheel build: the NixOS system build of the same version number emitted different bytes in 32/37 assets (verified 2026-09-15). (3) CI image install lines in declarative-config k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/brand-kit-ci-workflowtemplate.yml now pin exactly those versions (commit e92361b5, pushed; ArgoCD sync pending). (4) All 31 drifted assets regenerated with the pinned wheel toolchain and committed (cf9ff9e): two consecutive regens byte-identical, verify_assets.py passes, second run over the committed tree is a no-op. (5) README: fallback sentence replaced with the abort behavior + pinned setup; oxipng after-step flagged as regen-diff-incompatible; __pycache__/ ignored. Complements brandkit-cb866485 without duplicating it. Also absorbed brandkit-a013f77e: the uncommitted asset drift it tracked was reconciled as part of the canonical-toolchain regeneration.

Reconciled by brandkit-68d7b26c in brand-kit commit cf9ff9e: the uncommitted regeneration of avatars/, banners/, favicon/, logo/ was committed as part of the pinned-toolchain work. IMPORTANT provenance note: the committed bytes are the output of the canonical toolchain (resvg 0.47.0 + PyPI-wheel Pillow 12.1.1) recorded in docs/notes/asset-toolchain.md - NOT the NixOS system Pillow bytes that were sitting in the working tree before. Do not regenerate these assets with the system python3/Pillow; use a venv (pip install Pillow==12.1.1) or the regen-diff will flag every file again.

No stale doc, no missing asset — nothing to change or commit.
